summary: The RptMenuStudentExpenseClaims is a part of a web user control used for handling student expense claims reports within a given application. It mainly deals with rendering and validating report parameters, and executing and displaying the report results.
purpose: To provide an interface for generating and viewing student expense claim reports based on specified date ranges.

workflows.name: Generate Student Expense Claims Report
steps: User opens the report menu for student expense claims.
User selects start and end dates for the report.
Start and end dates are validated using RegularExpressionValidator and RequiredFieldValidator.
User clicks the button to generate the report.
On button click, a database stored procedure 'ReportExpenseClaims' is called with parameters 'SessionID', 'DateFrom', and 'DateTo'.
Database retrieves the report data which is then formatted into a CSV string.
If the report is successfully generated, it is displayed in the pnlReportHTML panel.

business_rules: The start and end dates must be provided by the user and validated.
The report generation will trigger a stored procedure call to get data.
validations: required field checks for start and end dates
system_behavior: User interactions with start and end date controls trigger corresponding calendar controls.
The system manages visibility of the report panel based on successful report generation.
exceptions: Potential data retrieval issues if no data is returned by the stored procedure.
